text: {"features":[{"name":"Role alignment","description":"Measures how clearly the letter explains why this specific security-engineering role at Google fits the applicant's background, interests, and next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in the role or company in generic terms that could fit many software jobs."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security or backend work as appealing, but the rationale for this specific role remains broad and underdeveloped."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter makes a clear connection between the applicant's experience and at least one core part of the role, such as secure defaults or foundational tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter links several aspects of the applicant's background to the team's mission and explains why this role is a logical next move."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes the role feel uniquely well matched to the applicant's trajectory, motivations, and prior work, creating a highly convincing fit narrative."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"Measures how well the letter shows understanding of the security-automation problems this team solves and the leverage such systems create.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter treats the position as generic security or backend work and shows no clear understanding of why automation matters here."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions automation in passing, but it does not explain the security bottleneck or leverage that automation addresses."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a basic grasp that security tooling can reduce manual work or make secure behavior easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how automation can scale scarce security expertise across teams through ideas like triage, secure defaults, or lifecycle integration."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows nuanced understanding of organizational security automation, such as variant analysis, bounded agents, or turning one expert finding into broad protective capacity."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"Measures how well the letter shows an enablement mindset toward serving developer teams with low-friction security tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no sign that developer workflows, adoption, or usability matter to the applicant's view of security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter refers generally to helping teams, but it does not show much thought about developers as users of the tooling."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly says security should be easier for engineers or mentions reducing friction in their workflow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly frames developers as users to support, emphasizing defaults, usability, or tools that fit how engineers actually work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows a strong developer-enablement philosophy grounded in prior work or explicit design principles, portraying security as supportive engineering rather than policing."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"Measures the strength of the applicant's formal educational preparation for a role that prefers advanced study in computer science or a related field.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents only a relevant bachelor's degree and gives no sign that formal study is a particular differentiator."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree and adds some signal of deeper technical seriousness, but it still falls short of the preferred advanced-degree profile."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree as a solid formal qualification for the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree as especially substantive advanced preparation or research-oriented training for this work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctoral degree as a major part of the applicant's technical foundation."}]},{"name":"Professional scope","description":"Measures the depth and breadth of directly relevant production software experience conveyed in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only near-minimum relevant tenure and narrow production exposure, such as few launched or maintained systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows relevant experience but with limited breadth of production ownership or a smaller set of shipped systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid mid-level production experience across multiple years and multiple services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial scope through several years of ownership across many production services or clear progression in responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows the deepest production scope, combining long tenure, repeated launches, and a convincing track record of owning critical systems over time."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Measures how strongly the letter establishes the applicant's depth with Go in production backend or systems work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go only lightly or not at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter identifies Go as one working language but gives little evidence that it is central to the applicant's production work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go clearly a primary or daily language in real systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter ties Go to backend or systems ownership relevant to security automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep Go-centric backend design, using Go for the control planes, services, or guardrails that matter most to this role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Measures how strongly the letter establishes production-level Python experience relevant to automation, services, or AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python or mentions it only incidentally."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter says Python is familiar or occasionally used, but it gives little sense of production depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a regular tool for automation, analysis, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong production use of Python across services and tooling with concrete examples relevant to the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter portrays Python as a mature engineering language for the applicant, emphasizing production quality, extensibility, testing, or its central role in agents and operational tooling."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Measures how convincingly the letter demonstrates strength with data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering use.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of data structures or algorithms competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims algorithmic strength in broad terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides one clear example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives a technically credible example tied to performance, scalability, or system simplification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses especially sharp or multiple examples that make algorithmic thinking feel like a meaningful strength central to the applicant's engineering approach."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Measures the extent and sophistication of the applicant's direct experience performing security assessments or reviews.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of performing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter alludes to security review experience in general terms without process, scope, or methods."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states direct experience with assessments such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows structured assessment work with concrete methods and follow-through, such as validating fixes or reviewing both new and existing systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter portrays security assessment as a practiced engineering discipline, showing depth in how the applicant reasons from design intent to implementation flaws."}]},{"name":"Triage automation track record","description":"Measures how convincingly the letter shows hands-on experience automating vulnerability intake, classification, routing, or remediation workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security automation broadly but does not describe a concrete triage or routing system."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building tooling that helped process vulnerability reports or reduce manual queue work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains a concrete triage pipeline with functions such as deduplication, classification, routing, or prioritization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows ownership of a clearly impactful vulnerability-handling automation system and explains how it materially returned expert time or made the queue largely self-running."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture experience","description":"Measures how strongly the letter demonstrates design and implementation experience with agentic systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of designing agentic systems or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents or autonomous workflows only vaguely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes direct involvement in building agentic tooling with Python agents or similar components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how agents and supporting services were structured, including constraints, supervision, or multi-step task execution."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents agentic architecture as a major strength, with clear design thinking about autonomy boundaries, guardrails, auditability, and the Go-Python split relevant to this role."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"Measures the depth of hands-on experience building and operating AI-backed features or systems in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of hands-on AI or LLM work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI interest or generic exposure without concrete production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows direct experience shipping AI-backed functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter adds evidence of operating AI responsibly, such as evaluation, hardening, or managing failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents applied AI as a mature production skill, combining shipped features with clear thinking about reliability, trust, and constraints."}]},{"name":"Operational rigor","description":"Measures how strongly the letter signals a habit of building reliable, constrained, maintainable systems rather than merely shipping features.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter emphasizes building features but gives little sign of reliability, guardrails, testing, or safety-minded engineering."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gestures toward dependable systems in general terms without showing how rigor is achieved."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes some concrete signs of rigor, such as typed or tested code, attention to maintenance, or bounded automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly shows a builder's concern for production safety through guardrails, auditability, failure handling, or maintainability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes rigorous, dependable engineering a defining theme, showing how systems are intentionally constrained, tested, and built to behave predictably under stress."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Measures how concrete and well-supported the letter's claims are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on abstract claims and adjectives with little concrete supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specifics such as employers or languages, but most qualifications remain generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter uses multiple concrete examples of work, technologies, or problems to support its claims."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides detailed, role-relevant examples that let a reader picture what the applicant actually built or assessed."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently grounds nearly every major claim in concrete context, technology, and task detail, making it highly evidentiary."}]},{"name":"Impact articulation","description":"Measures how clearly the letter translates past work into concrete outcomes, organizational value, or scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter lists responsibilities without explaining results, stakes, or benefits."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies positive outcomes but leaves them vague or unmeasured."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some concrete effect, such as faster systems, reduced manual work, or broader team usefulness."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter makes outcomes easy to understand through specific consequences, scale, or before-and-after framing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly translates technical work into clear organizational value, showing how the applicant's systems saved expert time, improved capacity, or hardened widely used infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Open-source contribution","description":"Measures the extent of credible contribution or maintenance work in open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions light or one-off open-source participation without showing sustained involvement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows periodic contribution, such as submitting patches when defects are found."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular, responsible contribution, including review, releases, or stewardship of a project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial open-source ownership or maintenance of a project or library with real external users or community expectations."}]},{"name":"Project ambition","description":"Measures the technical ambition and seriousness of personal engineering projects described in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of personal engineering work outside the day job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small side project or utility with limited technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a sustained personal project with meaningful engineering substance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes an ambitious systems project chosen to tackle hard failure modes, distributed behavior, or production-like constraints."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a highly ambitious self-directed build that demonstrates deep systems curiosity and execution well beyond routine side-project scope."}]},{"name":"Security practice","description":"Measures proactive security engagement outside normal job duties through competitions, certifications, or other sustained hands-on practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of security activity beyond normal software work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a light external signal, such as a basic security certification or occasional competition participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows one meaningful hands-on signal of security commitment, such as sustained CTF participation or a respected certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong extra-role security practice through a demanding certification, serious competition involvement, or similarly credible attacker-oriented practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents exceptional outside-the-job security engagement, such as elite CTF results, OSCP-level proof combined with other signals, or multiple strong indicators together."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"Measures how well the letter forms a cohesive, persuasive story rather than a disconnected list of credentials.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads as a loose list of qualifications with little through-line or progression."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a recognizable structure but weak transitions or an underdeveloped story about fit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a coherent case with a discernible arc from past work to present interest."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter builds a persuasive narrative that links career path, technical strengths, and role interest smoothly."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a memorable, tightly organized story in which the applicant's trajectory, motivations, and examples reinforce one another throughout."}]},{"name":"Professional voice","description":"Measures how engaging, authentic, and memorable the prose feels while remaining appropriate for a serious technical application.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The language feels stock, flat, or interchangeable with many other applications."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The prose is mostly generic and functional, with only slight traces of individuality."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some authentic or engaging phrasing, but it remains fairly conventional overall."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter has a distinctive, confident voice that makes it more memorable while staying professional."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter has a highly memorable and original voice that strengthens the case for fit without sounding gimmicky or unfocused."}]},{"name":"Mechanical polish","description":"Measures the professionalism of the writing through spelling, grammar, naming accuracy, and overall surface correctness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent distracting spelling, grammar, or naming errors that materially undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter contains several noticeable errors or awkward constructions but remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter contains a few minor errors that do not seriously damage credibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is mostly clean and professional, with at most isolated slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is clean, careful, and publication-level polished, with accurate naming and no noticeable mechanical errors."}]}]}
